title: Senior Backend Engineer, Buyer
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The Buyer Domain at Vinted is dedicated to creating a seamless and highly engaging experience for our members as they search, discover, and purchase items. Our challenge is unique: unlike standard e-commerce, our peer-to-peer catalogue consists of hundreds of millions of entirely unique, single-inventory listings, with millions of new items uploaded daily. Connecting the right buyer with the perfect item in real-time is at the very core of Vinted's success.

The CVP team owns the core platform and services that govern how content is geofenced, balanced, and surfaced across Vinted's growing international network of markets. We build robust systems and tooling that manage cross-border visibility, enabling smooth and gradual market connections (e.g., FR-DE, BE-FR-ES) while optimising key liquidity metrics like Sell-Through Rate (STR%) and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) by balancing the content in multiple channels.

Our team works closely with Content Visibility Management, Search, and Recommender relevance teams to accelerate product development. Currently, we are driving the automation of content visibility experimentation & analysis. Rather than having different content channels independently re-implement visibility controls, we are building a unified platform to provide autonomy to Decision Scientists. In addition, we are highly contributing in growing new large markets such as the USA and Australia.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Drive technical execution: Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable, reliable, and secure backend systems to ensure efficient content visibility and search mechanisms.
  • Guide technical decisions: Contribute to and challenge the technical direction of our backend services, leading system design reviews and ensuring high-quality, maintainable code.
  • Scale features globally: Implement and shape A/B tested features that positively impact our 80+ million users. Code changes are rolled out instantly to production.
  • Own your services: Monitor and improve backend service performance and stability. The team owns and monitors service-layer measurements (SLIs, SLOs, etc.) and has an on-call rotation which you will participate in.
  • Lead team-level initiatives: Lead and drive technical initiatives within the team, while collaborating on domain-wide integrations with other engineering teams (such as Search and Recommender relevance teams).
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with engineering and product managers, analysts, and other stakeholders, facilitating clear communication within the team and across domains.
  • Contribute to product direction: Provide technical feasibility assessments, identify technical risks, and provide effort estimations to help shape our team's product roadmap.
  • Foster engineering excellence: Mentor, guide, and share knowledge with other engineers in the team to support their technical growth and promote collaborative best practices

About you 

  • You have extensive experience in backend software engineering, with a proven track record of designing and building scalable, distributed, and highly available systems.
  • You are highly proficient in backend development. We primarily use Go, Kotlin, Ruby, Python — while prior experience in these specific languages is beneficial, a strong foundation in modern backend engineering and a willingness to learn is what matters most.
  • Experience with event streaming platforms like Kafka, Apache Flink, or others for real-time data processing and message queueing.
  • A track record working with search engines, information retrieval and ranking optimisations technologies (e.g., Vespa, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch) is a high advantage. If not, we expect you to have a strong willingness and motivation to learn.
